question_text: Which of the following is NOT an exchange-traded derivative?
solution_text: Forward contracts are customized over-the-counter (OTC) bilateral agreements, not traded on organized exchanges.

question_text: A market participant who enters into derivative contracts to eliminate or reduce the price risk of an existing asset is called a
solution_text: Hedgers use derivatives to protect their existing cash market positions from adverse price fluctuations.

question_text: Which of the following parties has an obligation but no right in an option contract?
solution_text: The option seller (writer) receives a premium and incurs an obligation to honor the contract if exercised by the buyer.

question_text: When the spot price of an underlying asset is higher than the strike price of a Call option the option is said to be
solution_text: For call options, when Spot Price > Strike Price, the option has positive intrinsic value and is In-The-Money (ITM).

question_text: State whether TRUE or FALSE: Futures contracts are standardized in terms of lot size expiry date and settlement procedure.
solution_text: Futures contracts are exchange-traded and strictly standardized by the exchange authority.

question_text: The process of daily adjustment of profit and loss resulting from market price movements in futures contracts is called
solution_text: Mark to Market (MTM) is the daily settlement where gains or losses are credited or debited based on closing settlement prices.

question_text: The legal mechanism through which a Clearing Corporation becomes the buyer to every seller and seller to every buyer is known as
solution_text: Novation replaces the contract between original counterparties with two contracts with the clearing house, eliminating counterparty risk.

question_text: Which option Greek measures the rate of change of Delta with respect to changes in the underlying asset price?
solution_text: Gamma measures the curvature or sensitivity of Delta relative to movements in the underlying price.

question_text: An American option can be exercised
option_b: Any time on or before the expiration date
solution_text: American options can be exercised at any point up to expiration, whereas European options can only be exercised on expiration date.

question_text: Intrinsic value of an Out-of-the-Money (OTM) option is always
solution_text: Intrinsic value cannot be negative. If an option is OTM, its intrinsic value is exactly zero.

question_text: Which risk is completely eliminated when trading through an exchange-backed Clearing Corporation?
solution_text: Clearing Corporations guarantee settlement of all trades, effectively eliminating counterparty default risk.

question_text: State whether TRUE or FALSE: The maximum potential loss for a buyer of a put option is limited to the premium paid.
solution_text: Option buyers only risk losing the upfront premium paid to the writer.

question_text: The time decay of an option premium is measured by which of the following Greeks?
solution_text: Theta measures the sensitivity of option value with respect to the passage of time (time decay).

question_text: In a cash-settled futures contract upon expiration
option_a: The physical commodity or shares are delivered
option_b: The difference between entry price and final settlement price is settled in cash
option_c: The contract is automatically rolled over without settlement
option_d: A new loan is created by the exchange
solution_text: In cash settlement, parties settle the financial difference without physical delivery of the underlying asset.

question_text: Which of the following strategies involves simultaneously buying a call option and selling a call option of the same underlying with different strikes?
solution_text: A vertical spread involves options of the same underlying and expiration but differing strike prices.
